say:2:1830164001:1.text: I waited years to reunite with you! And this is what you do to me?! I-I can't believe...
say:2:1830164001:1.source_cn: 我准备了这么多年，好不容易才来到诺珐斯，就想着能再见一...

say:3:1830164002:1.text: You actually married another woman here!
say:3:1830164002:1.source_cn: ——你竟然在这边有了新的家庭！

say:4:1830164003:1.text: Rosa... it's been twenty years since I died. I thought you'd have forgotten about me by now...
say:4:1830164003:1.source_cn: 罗莎……我已经去世二十年了，我以为你肯定会忘了我的……

say:5:1830164004:1.text: You should move on, Rosa... Don't throw away the good life ahead of you for a dead man like me.
say:5:1830164004:1.source_cn: 放下过去吧，罗莎……你该向前看了。别让我这样一个死人耽...

say:6:1830164005:1.text: Langdon... You really broke my heart saying that, you know?!
say:6:1830164005:1.source_cn: 雷德……你怎么能说出这样的话？！

say:7:1830164006:1.text: Um, I've got a new name now—Langwin.
say:7:1830164006:1.source_cn: 呃，其实我现在已经不叫雷德了，我叫累德。

say:8:1830164007:1.text: ... Langwin? More like Lang-LOSE! You two-timing loser!

say:9:1830164008:1.text: I never want to see your face again, alive or dead!
say:9:1830164008:1.source_cn: 我这辈子再也不想见到你了！不……我连死后也不要再见到你！
